newsitem.title: BRAZIL: U.S. Guardian group to build $150 mln Brazil plant.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Guardian group to build $150 mln Brazil plant.

text.p: U.S. sheet glass manufacturer Guardian Group will build a $150 million sheet glass factory in Brazil to supply the domestic and other South American markets, the head of its Brazilian operation said.

Mark Lacassi, director of Guardian do Brasil, told reporters the factory, to be built in Rio de Janeiro state and expected to come on line in June 1998, would have a production capacity of 600 tonnes of sheet glass a day and employ 250 workers.
He said it was Guardian's first Brazil factory and that economic stabilization had made it viable. Previously, Guardian imported glass to Brazil from Venezuela.
Lacassi said 20-30 percent of production would be exported to other Mercosur countries.
